sourcePolicy.note: All scene evidence entries contain official links. Some pages were verified via indexed official snippets or reused prior verified sources, not live full-page retrieval; no GIS parcel-level check. All dialogues fictional; only explicitly sourced actual joint activity claimed.

recommendation: No further automatic production. Remaining IL-12 and TN-01 are B not D; first evaluate targeted enhancements to existing content, then HQ can decide whether one or two additional comparison scenes are warranted. Four nongeographic omitted candidates duplicate existing baseline or belong in P07/P10; defer.
limitations: This is a production self-check and predicted learning coverage, not independent Q2/Q4 re-audit.
Baseline 2,000 compact rows plus prior 50 compare normalized target text; later edits to earlier scenes not all re-read. Similarity flags do not establish semantic uniqueness.
Official district descriptions and address search used; full GIS map geometry and 2027 boundaries not checked. Some assignments are office location rather than constituent residence.
Photographs are references only; no rendering, license re-audit, gameplay integration or browser testing performed.
Most scenes still use a document/map comparison situation, with distinct facts and roles but limited structural diversity. No actual meeting is asserted.
